question: What is the most laps f1 races had? Name the race, year and circuit location where the races with most laps was hosted.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    r.name,
    r.year,
    cl.location
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN CircuitLocation AS cl ON r.circuitId = cl.circuitId
ORDER BY res.laps DESC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T2.name, T2.year, T1.location
FROM CircuitLocation AS T1
JOIN CircuitDetails AS T1__evo2 ON T1__evo2.circuitId = T1.circuitId
JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitId = T1.circuitId
JOIN results AS T3 ON T3.raceId = T2.raceId
ORDER BY T3.laps DESC
LIMIT 1
